positioning: A source-led kitchen buying publication: make capacity, counter space and care requirements easier to compare without pretending to test products.
authorship: Zone1 Kitchen publishes AI-assisted, documentation-based research. No named human editor, product ownership or hands-on experience has been established.
reader_capture: RSS only. No email form, mailing-list provider or subscriber database is deployed.

cadence.status: operating plan, not a scheduled autonomous publisher
cadence.rhythm: Review source changes weekly; prepare at most one useful new or substantially refreshed guide every two weeks. Publish only after primary-source, disclosure, link and build checks pass.
cadence.seasonal: Review gift and sale-checking guides ahead of the relevant retail season. The November 2026 selection is editorial context, not proof of search demand or a deal.
cadence.kill_rule: Do not publish a second article answering the same question. Improve the existing canonical guide instead. Hold a draft if its claims require unverified identity, unauthorised API content or invented first-party results.
cadence.measurement: Once authorised Search Console and first-party aggregates exist, review query impressions, clicks and guide-to-product actions over a dated comparable period before changing priorities. There is currently no such dataset.

products.title: Chefman 6 Qt Dual Basket
products.dek: Two separate baskets for dishes with different settings. Sync Finish coordinates their finish times.
products.check: Match the dual-window model number; Chefman sells similar-looking variants.
products.verdict: Worth comparing if separate cooking settings matter more to you than one undivided basket. The manual documents two 3-quart baskets, Sync Baskets and Sync Finish; that does not establish how much your usual meal will fit or how it will taste.

products.title: Emeril 26 Qt French Door
products.dek: A French-door oven cavity with a documented rotisserie. Start with the footprint and care instructions.
products.check: The preset and accessory counts disagree across the official documents.
products.verdict: Worth comparing if you want an oven-style layout and the documented rotisserie function. The 26-quart cavity is not a serving guarantee. Leave room for the doors and the manual’s required ventilation; its cleaning section recommends hand-washing the accessories.

products.title: Chefman 8 Qt TurboFry
products.dek: A single-basket format for one batch. Check the model carefully: the 450 °F title conflicts with its documents.
products.check: The RJ38-SQSS-8T brand page says 400 °F; the observed listing title advertises 450 °F.
products.verdict: Worth comparing if you prefer one basket to dividing food between two drawers. For RJ38-SQSS-8T, Chefman documents four presets and a 200–400 °F range. The listing title’s 450 °F Hi-Fry wording remains a conflict, not an extra feature this guide can promise.
